items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled OUT for Week 7 vs Bengals with ankle injury after earlier questionable designation; Tyler Huntley starts again.
items.why: Ravens downgraded Saturday; high ankle sprain, third straight miss.
items.implication: Huntley start; Ravens pass game and dual-threat upside reduced.

items.text: Puka Nacua listed GTD/OPTIMISM Sunday morning with calf; later confirmed ACTIVE vs Raiders.
items.why: Rams optimistic Saturday; no setbacks, feeling better; Schefter/Rapoport/Berry confirm active.
items.implication: Full or near-full WR1 role expected; start with confidence in 4:25 window.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets as primary option with Adams out.

items.text: Breece Hall GTD/PESSIMISM morning; officially INACTIVE vs Dolphins after limited practices and early return attempt from quad.
items.why: Not full participant; Rapoport unlikely then inactive confirmed by Schefter.
items.implication: Misses fourth straight; ramp for Week 8.
items.opportunity: Lead back role remains with backup (volume carries/targets).

items.text: Thinks Cam Skattebo is actually hurt (hamstring) post 124/17/1 lead-back outing vs Texans, but not certain.
items.why: Post-game report; produced as expected lead but Levitan skeptical of full health.
items.implication: Monitor practice; potential limited snaps or backup opportunity next week.
items.opportunity: If limited, Tracy or other Giants RBs gain carries.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs ankle turned on purposeful slide almost certainly fine; would have been tilting if real injury from smart non-score.
items.why: Purposeful slide; no indication of structural issue.
items.implication: No downgrade ROS/next week; maintain elite RB status.

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY Monday vs Cowboys despite questionable/hamstring tag.
items.why: ETR summary and beat reports; efficient prior games, strong matchup.
items.implication: Start as RB1/2 if active; volume likely.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks both OUT for Eagles (hamstring/ankle); impacts Monday pass game.
items.implication: Elevated targets/routes for remaining pass catchers; Saquon checkdowns possible.
items.opportunity: WR target share consolidation; TE/Goedert upside.

items.text: Josh Jacobs activated/IN and expected to play for Packers vs Lions after exempt list.
items.why: Packers activated Saturday; Schefter expected to play.
items.implication: Workload question after layoff; monitor snap share vs committee.

items.text: Panthers OT Taylor Moton fractured fibula, out indefinitely after return from blood clot; carted off vs Bucs.
items.why: Fractured fibula in game; coach confirmed.
items.implication: OL degradation may affect run blocking long-term; Pollard still produced 3 TDs short-term.
items.opportunity: Short-term run game volume if scheme adjusts, but pass protection risk.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI for usage/matchup; Bears defense yields yardage, Brown back in real role (WR10 rank context).
items.why: Usage rebound + soft Bears secondary; volume expected.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 start; high target/route share.

items.text: Loves Tucker Kraft @ DET; Lions TE buffet (9 TE TDs allowed), Kraft TE6 upside.
items.why: Detroit allows elite TE production; Kraft volume in Packers offense.

items.text: Loves volume RBs Jaylen Warren @ NO, Chuba Hubbard vs TB, Bucky Irving @ CAR for big workloads in friendly matchups.
items.why: Consistent volume + defenses carved by RBs; Hubbard consistency, Warren/Irving matchups.

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze vs NE (Gonzalez shadow, outside targets) and Josh Downs @ MIN (target-share/low-scoring issues).
items.why: Nasty matchups/roles; Odunze 90% outside, Downs share problems.

items.text: Hates Josh Jacobs @ DET (workload post-long layoff) and Cam Skattebo @ HOU (brutal spot).
items.why: Jacobs layoff risk; Skattebo tough matchup despite lead role.
items.implication: Fade/sit relative to ADP/rank; prefer volume alternatives.
items.conflict: Jacobs activated/expected (ETR/Schefter); Skattebo produced big but post-hamstring watch
